name: Duopharma Biotech Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司公告主要涉及诉讼事项、股息派发及董事会委员会人事变动，未披露业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售，也未披露新合约或订单。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长5.7%，净利润同比增长47.8%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly involved litigation matters, dividend payments, and changes in board committee memberships. No expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment of business segments was disclosed, nor were new contracts or orders. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue grew 5.7% year-on-year and net profit grew 47.8% year-on-year.
